verdicts.reason: A keeps the original top-to-bottom order and a strong hierarchy. However, the headline is broken into five lines of mostly one word each, so it overpowers everything else. The logo is microscopic, and the CTA and legal text are jammed against the bottom edge. B puts the logo below the sale ribbon, which breaks the reading order. Its legal text is as large as the subcopy, the CTA label is tiny, and all the content sits in the top two-thirds, leaving about 170px of empty space at the bottom.
